name: Stochastic Solid Volume Rendering
definition: A rendering technique used instead of vanilla 3DGS rasterization to improve geometric fidelity. It is equivalent to 3DGS rasterization under suitable conditions with an appropriate vacancy function.
summary: Stochastic Solid Volume Rendering is a technique that improves geometric fidelity and reduces depth map artifacts compared to standard 3D Gaussian Splatting by reformulating the rendering integral with a vacancy function.
